description.value: Pizza Factory has been a neighbourhood pizza staple in Burnaby's Metrotown area since 1996. The menu spans customizable pizzas in multiple sizes alongside pastas, salads, and sides, with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free crust options available. Situated on the Kingsway corridor, it offers both walk-in pickup and online ordering, making it a practical refuelling option for cyclists passing through the area.
